correctness.rationale: For every even n≥4, the source establishes the exact flag incompatibility graph and homology concentrated in dimension n/2−1 with rank two. Fixed-simplex signed Lefschetz trace is negative independence-polynomial evaluation at −1 on the reflection orbit quotient. Under s_0 a fixed spoke orbit is isolated; under s_1 open-twin cancellations reduce the quotient to a path of n/2 triangles. The two-state recurrence f_j=(1+z)f_(j−1)+g_(j−1), g_j=z f_(j−1) proves the parity-dependent formula for every n. The published rotation trace and square give the dihedral module corollary. A local standard-library verifier independently enumerates perfect matchings, incompatible pairs, orbit quotients and signed facet-based Lefschetz traces, passes all finite checks; computations corroborate and are not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 homotopy theorem naturally leaves a homology-symmetry gap after the known rotation calculation. The new even-width reflection character sharply separates two geometrically distinct axis conjugacy classes and proves that exactly the widths n≡2 mod8 have a nonzero class invariant under the entire natural dihedral group. This is an infinite structural representation classification that cannot be recovered from ranks or, for n≡2 mod4, from the known cyclic character; the n≡0 mod4 component is honestly marked as already implied.
